rules: Every varying dimension that would collide if collapsed MUST appear as its own labeled segment.
Sanitize: lowercase; spaces to '-'; '+N' to 'plus-N'; '%' to 'pct'; strip unsafe chars; join segments with '_'.
Same ordered label set -> same basename (deterministic); different label sets -> different basenames.
Content hash may append as a short suffix AFTER human labels, never instead of them.
asset-manifest stores the human path; hash stays a separate asset field.
Do not rewrite published blob history; stop emitting new hashy basenames on pins >= 0.5.5.
apply_checklist: Identify the naming surface (generated artifact filename, asset-manifest path, or committed media basename).
Collect ordered dimension labels for every colliding axis.
MUST load modules/human-output-naming/SKILL.md and call scripts/human_filename.build_basename before write.
Record the human path in the manifest; keep hash as a field (suffix only after human labels if needed).
Do not rewrite published blob history unless a scoped migration requires it.
acs_prompt_inject_note: After hotload verify, mention output filenames and asset-manifest paths (not titles only): MUST load human-output-naming (hon) before naming generated artifacts.
